headline: Palolem Beach Named Asia's Top Beach for 2026
summary: Palolem Beach in Goa has been crowned Asia's best beach for 2026. It was also ranked as the 6th best beach globally in recent international rankings.

headline: Mormugao MLA Sankalp Amonkar Joins Goa Cabinet
summary: Mormugao MLA Sankalp Amonkar has been inducted as a cabinet minister in the Goa government. The move fulfills a promise made by the ruling BJP.

headline: FC Goa Upset Over Controversial Stoppage-Time Loss to Bengaluru FC
summary: FC Goa expressed strong frustration following a controversial stoppage-time winning goal by Bengaluru FC. The defeat left the Goa club upset over the refereeing decisions.

headline: High Court Orders ECI to Restore Goa Family on Electoral Rolls
summary: The High Court has directed the Election Commission of India to restore the names of a Goa family to the electoral rolls. The decision comes after their names were previously deleted during a revision.

headline: Sankalp Amonkar Sworn In as Goa Cabinet Minister
summary: Sankalp Amonkar has taken the oath of office as a new minister in the Goa state cabinet. His induction fills a vacant slot in the state ministry.

headline: Goa's Traditional Diwali Celebrations Shift Toward Modern Trends
summary: Diwali celebrations in Goa are witnessing a gradual shift from traditional, eco-friendly practices toward modern trends. The change reflects evolving cultural preferences during the festival season.

headline: NIO Transfers Coral Reef Tech to Odisha Firm
summary: Goa's National Institute of Oceanography has transferred its coral reef monitoring technology to an Odisha-based firm. The technology transfer aims to support environmental research and marine conservation efforts.

headline: South Goa Sees 12% Rise in Accidents but 30% Drop in Fatalities
summary: Road accidents in South Goa increased by 12 percent recently, according to traffic police statistics. However, road fatalities dropped significantly by 30 percent during the same period.

headline: First UK Charter Flight Arrives in Goa with 300 Tourists
summary: The first UK charter flight of the season landed in Goa, bringing 300 international tourists to the state. The arrival marks a boost for the seasonal tourism industry.

headline: BJP MLA Sankalp Amonkar Formally Inducted into Goa Cabinet
summary: BJP MLA Sankalp Amonkar has officially joined the Pramod Sawant-led Goa cabinet. He was administered the oath of office during a formal ceremony.

headline: High Court Bans Outdoor Loudspeakers After Midnight for Narakasura
summary: The Bombay High Court has ruled that no outdoor music on loudspeakers is permitted past midnight during Narakasura effigy burnings in Goa. The order strictly enforces noise pollution limits during Diwali.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat May Affect 13 Trains and 15,000 Riders
summary: The upcoming Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express service may disrupt the operational schedules of 13 other trains. The changes could impact an estimated 15,000 rail passengers along the route.

headline: Western Ghats Route for New Vande Bharat May Cause Rail Disruptions
summary: The new Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat route passing through the Western Ghats is projected to alter train schedules on the coastal network. Approximately 15,000 passengers are likely to be affected by the changes.

headline: Bastian Riviera Opens New Riverside Stay with Swim-Up Rooms in Goa
summary: Hospitality brand Bastian Riviera has launched a new riverside resort property in Goa featuring luxury swim-up rooms. The property offers guests a novel accommodation experience along the water.

headline: Minister Rane Meets Valpoi Self-Help Groups to Promote Welfare Schemes
summary: Minister Vishwajit Rane interacted with members of women self-help groups in Valpoi to discuss government support initiatives. He highlighted various welfare schemes designed to empower local women economically.

headline: Telangana Man Arrested in ₹95 Lakh Online Fraud Case
summary: Goa Cybercrime Police have arrested a man from Telangana for his alleged involvement in an online investment scam worth ₹95 lakh. The suspect was apprehended following an investigation into financial fraud complaints.

headline: Goa to Create Digital Video Lessons for Primary and Middle School Students
summary: The Goa education department is preparing digital video lessons tailored for students in Classes 1 through 8. The initiative aims to enhance interactive learning across state schools.

headline: Goa CM Advocates Reopening 153 Mining Leases in Western Ghats
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has pushed for reopening 153 iron ore mining leases situated in ecologically sensitive areas of the Western Ghats. The proposal seeks to resume mining activities to boost state revenues.

headline: Traffic Police Issue Safety Guidelines Ahead of Narkasur Displays
summary: Goa Traffic Police have urged the public and festival organizers to strictly follow road safety rules during Narkasur effigy displays. The advisory aims to prevent traffic congestion and accidents during Diwali night.

headline: Archbishop Filipe Neri Ferrão Extends Diwali Wishes for Peace and Unity
summary: Archbishop Filipe Neri Ferrão extended warm Diwali greetings to citizens across Goa. He emphasized the importance of communal harmony and interfaith dialogue during the festive season.

headline: FC Goa Files Complaint with AIFF and ISL Over Officiating Issues
summary: FC Goa has formally written to the All India Football Federation and Indian Super League organizers regarding controversial referee decisions. The complaint follows their contested defeat against Bengaluru FC.

headline: HC Mandates Nighttime Ban on Outdoor Sound from Midnight to 6 AM
summary: The High Court has enforced a strict prohibition on all outdoor music and sound systems in Goa between midnight and 6 AM. The decision aims to curb noise pollution during night hours.

headline: Marine Scientist Dr Lata Gawade Invited to Kyoto Prize Ceremony
summary: Goan marine scientist Dr. Lata Gawade has been invited to participate in the prestigious Kyoto Prize ceremony in Japan. The invitation highlights her scientific contributions to coastal and marine research.

headline: Sankalp Amonkar Officially Takes Oath as Goa Cabinet Minister
summary: MLA Sankalp Amonkar officially took the oath of office as a cabinet minister in Goa. The swearing-in ceremony fills a long-vacant position in the state leadership.

headline: Eight Students of Little Flower of Jesus High School Win State Award
summary: Eight Scouts and Guides from Little Flower of Jesus High School in Goa have been honored with the State Award for 2026. The students were recognized for exemplary performance and service.

headline: Proposed Vande Bharat Service Set to Reschedule 13 Trains
summary: A report indicates that introducing the Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express may disrupt 13 existing train schedules along the route. Nearly 15,000 passengers could be impacted by the changes.

headline: Sankalp Amonkar Inducted into Cabinet Ahead of 2027 Goa Polls
summary: Goa MLA Sankalp Amonkar has been sworn into Chief Minister Pramod Sawant's cabinet. The political appointment comes as parties prepare ahead of the 2027 state assembly elections.

headline: Mandrem Woman Succumbs to Injuries Days After Scooter Crash
summary: A woman from Mandrem has died in the hospital several days after sustaining severe injuries in a scooter accident. Police registered the case following her passing.

headline: TCP Department Classifies 37 Lakh Sqm as Non-Developable Land
summary: Goa's Town and Country Planning Department has updated its land use plans to add 37 lakh square meters to non-developable zones. The move aims to protect eco-sensitive spaces across the state.

headline: Cabinet Expansion: Sankalp Amonkar Inducted as Minister
summary: Sankalp Amonkar has officially joined the Goa state cabinet as a minister. The swearing-in ceremony was conducted by state authorities in Panaji.

headline: Goa Police Arrest Telangana Resident in ₹95 Lakh Investment Scam
summary: Goa Cybercrime Police have taken a Telangana resident into custody over a ₹95 lakh online investment scam. The arrest follows financial tracking by local law enforcement officers.

headline: 12 Men Busted Operating Multi-Crore Scam from Luxury Goa Villa
summary: Police uncovered a multi-crore financial fraud operation run by 12 young men out of a luxury villa in Goa. The suspects allegedly targeted victims across the country using online schemes.

headline: Man Nabbed for ₹95 Lakh Cyber Fraud in Goa
summary: Cybercrime sleuths have arrested a Telangana man for allegedly defrauding a Goa resident of ₹95 lakh in an online investment trap. Further investigation into the network is ongoing.

headline: FC Goa Target First Home Win Against In-Form Bengaluru FC
summary: FC Goa aim to stabilize their season performance as they prepare to clash with an in-form Bengaluru FC side. The home team is searching for its first victory on home ground.

headline: Unused ₹35 Crore Campal Sports Complex Remains Locked in Goa
summary: The ₹35 crore Campal Sports Complex in Goa remains locked and unutilized due to ongoing delays in sports policy execution. Local athletes continue to face limited access to training facilities.

headline: Coastal Train Schedules Face Alterations Due to New Vande Bharat
summary: The proposed Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express is expected to cause schedule alterations for 13 trains operating along the coastal rail route. Rail authorities are assessing the potential operational impact.

headline: Woman Granted Bail in Overseas Job Scam Case
summary: A court in Goa has granted bail to a woman accused of involvement in an overseas job placement fraud. She was arrested after several job seekers filed complaints of deception.

headline: 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' Campaign Launched in Goa
summary: A political campaign titled 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' is being launched in Goa to address electoral concerns. Organizers aim to raise awareness regarding voter rights and democratic integrity.

headline: High Court Orders ECI to Restore Deleted Names of Six Family Members
summary: The High Court of Bombay at Goa has directed the Election Commission of India to reinstate Paresh Salgaonkar and five family members on the voter roll. Their names had been deleted during a summary revision drive.

headline: Sankalp Amonkar Set to Join Goa Cabinet After Four-Year Wait
summary: MLA Sankalp Amonkar is scheduled to take oath as a cabinet minister in the Goa government, ending a four-year wait for a cabinet berth. The appointment fills a post left vacant in the state ministry.

headline: HC Rules in Favor of Goa Family Stripped of Voting Rights
summary: The Bombay High Court ruled that six members of a Goa family whose names were removed during the Special Summary Revision must be placed back on the electoral roll.

headline: Goa to Implement AI-Driven Governance for Welfare Scheme Distribution
summary: The Goa government plans to deploy artificial intelligence to streamline the delivery of state schemes and welfare benefits. The digital governance move aims to ensure transparent and direct disbursement to citizens.

headline: Congress Accuses Ruling BJP of Land, Job, and Electoral Misconduct
summary: Opposition party Congress has leveled allegations against the ruling BJP in Goa, claiming widespread fraud in land deals, recruitment, and voter list management. The BJP has denied the allegations.

headline: High Court Approves ₹20 Lakh Compensation for Nightclub Fire Victims
summary: The Bombay High Court has sanctioned interim compensation of ₹20 lakh each for victims of a fatal Goa nightclub fire incident. The financial relief aims to assist the affected families.

headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Expected to Be India's Slowest Vande Train
summary: The upcoming Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express is slated to operate at lower average speeds due to the steep gradients and curves along the Western Ghats section. It will reportedly be the slowest Vande Bharat route in India.

headline: 80% of Deleted Voters in Goa Shifted, Untraceable, or Disqualified
summary: Official electoral data indicates that 80 percent of voters recently deleted from Goa's rolls were removed because they relocated, became untraceable, or met disqualification criteria.

headline: Goa IT Department Announces Startup Incentives for Women and Students
summary: The Department of Information Technology in Goa has notified special financial incentives for female entrepreneurs and students under the state's startup policy. The move aims to encourage local innovation and entrepreneurship.

headline: Rivar Group Signs ₹3,000 Crore MoU with Goa for Sports Infrastructure
summary: Rivar Group has executed a Memorandum of Understanding worth ₹3,000 crore with the Goa government to develop a major sports infrastructure project. The investment aims to boost sports tourism and regional facilities.

headline: Sankalp Amonkar Inducted into Cabinet to Fill Vacant Ministerial Seat
summary: MLA Sankalp Amonkar has been inducted into the Goa cabinet to fill the ministerial vacancy created after the death of former minister Ravi Naik.

headline: CM Announces Day Passes for Goan Residents at IFFI 2026
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that day passes will be made available to local residents for the upcoming International Film Festival of India. The initiative aims to enhance local access to festival screenings.
